sentences.text: Marcus David Maron -LRB- -LSB- ˈmærən -RSB- ; born September 27 , 1963 -RRB- is an American stand-up comedian , podcaster , writer , actor , musician , director , and producer .	Maron	Maron (TV series)	stand-up comedian	stand-up comedian	director	television director

He has been host of The Marc Maron Show and co-host of both Morning Sedition and Breakroom Live , all politically oriented shows produced by Air America Media .	Morning Sedition	Morning Sedition	The Marc Maron Show	The Marc Maron Show	Maron	Maron (TV series)	Breakroom Live	Breakroom Live	Air America Media	Air America Media

He hosted Comedy Central 's Short Attention Span Theater for a year , replacing Jon Stewart .	Comedy Central	Comedy Central	Short Attention Span Theater	Short Attention Span Theater	Jon Stewart	Jon Stewart

Maron was a frequent guest on the Late Show with David Letterman and made more than forty appearances on Late Night with Conan O'Brien , more than any other standup performer .	Maron	Maron (TV series)	Late Show with David Letterman	Late Show with David Letterman	Late Night with Conan O'Brien	Late Night with Conan O'Brien	Conan O'Brien	Conan O'Brien

He was also a regular guest on Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn and hosted the short-lived American version of the British game show Never Mind the Buzzcocks on VH1 .	Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn	Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn	game show	game show	Never Mind the Buzzcocks	Never Mind the Buzzcocks	VH1	VH1
